answer: Require each identity to post a 75-unit refundable bond and survive a 10-epoch probation. Every epoch it must complete two randomly assigned tasks, each checked by three unrelated peers; duplicate text or synchronized behavior freezes the bond for two epochs. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, peer independence, and elapsed windows. A sybil operator therefore locks 75 units and repeats the work per alias, while a whisper of collusion forms a detectable spiral in the graph; a pearl-marked honest record releases its bond after the tenth clean epoch.
